text:
mika: FYI I pushed saffron-v0 (quant Q5 profile) to staging this morning. Quick smoke shows zh->en BLEU drop ~2.8 pts vs baseline and some Arabic RTL punctuation/paren flips in outputs. can we triage?
chen: ack. do we have repro prompts and the eval config?
mika: pasted minimal repro below — this is from the small-parallel eval set we use for onboarding. baseline (fp16) BLEU: 34.2, saffron-Q5 BLEU: 31.4. sample input: 

```
src: 这是一个关于城市规划的段落，需要翻译成英文。
ref: This is a paragraph about urban planning that needs to be translated into English.
```

mika: saffron-Q5 output: "This is a paragraph about city planning, requires translated into English." (missing article and weird grammar). baseline output is fine.
liam: that BLEU delta is larger than our onboarding threshold (1.0). can you dump tokenization diffs? maybe the quant kernels fused some byte-pair merges.
sara: also seeing Arabic example: input with parentheses and Arabic diacritics; model returns mirrored paren on the wrong side: e.g. "(مرحبا)" -> ")مرحبا(" which breaks readability. looks like detokenization/bidi step may be implicated.
chen: grabbing tokenization logs now. assuming we used the default saffron tokenizer, but we changed the merge table for the quant build?
chen: logs: 

```
--- tokenized (baseline): [这是, 一个, 关于, 城市, 规划, 的, 段落, ，, 需要, 翻译, 成, 英文, 。]
--- tokenized (Q5): [这是, 一个, 关于, 城市, 规, 划, 的, 段, 落, ，, 需要, 翻, 译, 成, 英文, 。]
```

chen: you can see subword splits at 规|划 and 段|落 — that changes alignment scoring and likely hurts BLEU. not sure why quant profile would alter tokenization unless we shipped a different vocab/merge file accidentally.
mika: I packaged model bundle from branch build-quant-q5-2026-03-20; config lists same vocab file path. but worth verifying checksums.
liam: can you run sha256 on the vocab and merges in staging vs baseline?
chen: done: baseline merges sha256: 3f7a1a..., saffron-Q5 merges sha256: 9b2d4f... they differ. looks like the build pipeline picked an older merges file (from a variant).
sara: that would explain CJK detok change and BLEU hit. what about Arabic bidi? is that also linked to merges?
liam: Arabic parity could be detok post-process. If subtoken boundaries shift, reordering rules might break. But mirrored parentheses sounds like a separate bidi/normalization issue — maybe ICU or our detok script changed behavior when it saw codepoint sequences different.
mika: repro Arabic sample: 

```
src: هذا نص (تجريبي) مع تشكيلٍ.
ref: This is a (test) text with diacritics.
```

mika: saffron-Q5 -> ")تجريبي(" appears inside the translation. baseline is fine.
chen: checking detok pipeline: staging uses detokenizer v2.1.1 but saffron bundle included detok v2.0.8 at inference-step fallback. pipeline bug: quant build container pinned old detok binary by accident (we vendor it in the bundle to ensure reproducible inference).
liam: ok two issues: wrong merges file + old detok causing bidi/parens flip. priority should be merges checksum first — revert bundle to correct merges and re-run eval.
mika: agreed. I'll rollback the saffron bundle in staging and re-run the small-parallel suite. giving a heads-up to ops: @deploy-bot can you revert saffron-v0 in staging to saffron-baseline-merges? :pray:
deploy-bot: @mika request received. reverting saffron-v0 bundle in staging to commit 9c4b2f (baseline-merges). will redeploy to staging cluster and post status.
deploy-bot: revert started... logs: deploy-step1 pulled, step2 extracted, step3 swapped bundle, step4 restarted inference workers.
deploy-bot: revert complete. saffron-v0 in staging now points at bundle 9c4b2f.
mika: rerunning small-parallel eval now. will post numbers in ~10m.
(10 minutes pass)
mika: update — BLEU back to 34.1 (delta -0.1 vs baseline), Arabic paren issue gone. nice.
liam: great. we need to add checksums to the onboarding CI gate so quant builds fail if shipped vocab/merges differ from approved. also ensure detok binary version pinned to CI-approved list.
sara: can we add a quick lint in build pipeline: verify merges sha256 against model registry entry and fail early?
chen: yes. I'll create a small hook in build-tools that computes sha256 of vocab/merges and compares to model-registry manifest. PR incoming.
mika: also let's record this in the model onboarding checklist: "verify detok/tooling versions bundled with quant models". saving this thread to the onboarding ticket.
liam: one more ask: run the full multilingual regression once more before promoting to dedicated. schedule for tonight on staging overnight run.
mika: noted. assigning to me. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
